content: Phase 1: POC — Next 16 + Tailwind 4 + fontsource boot, awaited params/searchParams, data-layer preflight stream into a client leaf, Server Action upload to .uploads/, integer peso maths, tsc strict + production build

Phase 1: Data layer — types.ts, domain.ts, money.ts, dates.ts, api/{clock,store,jobs,quotes,preflight,imposition,presses,customers,pricing,session,uploads} + fixtures (5 customers, 24 jobs, 3 presses, price matrix, 4 preflight reports)
Phase 1: Verify quote/press/imposition arithmetic and deterministic dates against the fixtures
Phase 2: Design guidelines from design_agent and globals.css token layer
Phase 2: Shared furniture components (status marks, CMYK progress strip, registration target, crop-mark frame, skeletons) and the five route-group shells with role gating
Phase 2: Routes 1-3 — / , /specs (SVG bleed diagram, anchors, metadata), /quote (URL-state calculator)
Phase 2: Route 4 — /sign-in with demo role picker writing the session cookie
Phase 2: Routes 5-7 — /app job table, /app/jobs/[id] spine (timeline, preflight, proof viewer, approve+confirm, comments), /app/new streaming upload
Phase 2: Routes 8-9 — /prepress queue, /prepress/jobs/[id] waive/override + live SVG imposition planner
Phase 2: loading.tsx skeletons for every route, error.tsx, not-found.tsx
Phase 2: typecheck strict + production build clean, no component imports a fixture, no setTimeout in any component, zero unused deps
Phase 2: All user stories covered in development
Phase 2: End to End Testing using Testing Agent (97%, all follow-ups fixed and re-verified)
